visual.detailed_description: Black-and-white flow diagram of rectangular text boxes joined by thin arrows: two model boxes at the top, a layer of mechanism boxes below them and a bottom row of boxes quoting delusional statements, with two labelled block arrows at the left edge. At the top left a box reads "One-stage model “experimental” [11, 47]" and at the top right a box reads "Two-stage model “inferential” [27, 45, 46]". From the one-stage box two diagonal arrows run down to two boxes, "Global disconnection of the sensory areas of the limbic system." on the left and "Local disconnection: facial recognition of the limbic system." in the middle. A vertical arrow runs from the left box down to a bottom box reading "Cotard: “I'm dead,” “I do not exist.”" and another from the middle box to a bottom box reading "Capgras: “He is an impostor,” “She's not my wife.”". From the two-stage box a vertical arrow runs down to a wide box reading "Damage to the neuroanatomical pathways responsible for proper emotional response to familiar visual stimuli.", then another vertical arrow to a wide box reading "Personal experience: “That woman looks like my wife, but I feel that is it.”". Two diagonal arrows leave this box to two bottom boxes reading "Internal attributional style (Cotard): “I'm dead.”" and "External attributional style (Capgras): “She's not my wife.”". Two boxes at the left edge, "Anomalous perceptual experiences" at the height of the upper layer and "Reasoning" at the height of the bottom row, each sit in front of a right-pointing block arrow. No panel letters, patient names or identification numbers are visible.

Third layer on the right: a wide box reading "Personal experience: “That woman looks like my wife, but I feel that is it.”".

Bottom row: four boxes reading "Cotard: “I'm dead,” “I do not exist.”", "Capgras: “He is an impostor,” “She's not my wife.”", "Internal attributional style (Cotard): “I'm dead.”" and "External attributional style (Capgras): “She's not my wife.”".

Arrows are thin solid black lines with open arrowheads: two diagonal arrows from the one-stage box, a vertical arrow below each of the two second-layer boxes on the left, a vertical arrow from the two-stage box, a vertical arrow below the damage box and two diagonal arrows below the personal experience box.

At the left edge two boxes, "Anomalous perceptual experiences" at the level of the second layer and "Reasoning" at the level of the bottom row, are each drawn in front of a right-pointing outlined block arrow.
Square-bracket numbers in the two top boxes are printed citation numbers; no other numbers, units or axes are printed.
